messages:
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline reported canary health failures for rollout model-embed-v2 -> us-west-2 at 2024-09-02T14:12:02Z. 5/5 canary replicas failing healthcheck, p95 latency spiked >6s. triggering PagerDuty. PD#INC-12345 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired (P1) for service=runtime-canary in us-west-2, alert_id=PD-INC-12345, page targets: @maria (primary), @next-oncall (secondary)
maria: ack — investigating now. grabbing logs and canary status.
maria: quick status: canary pod restarts + 502s in sidecar logs, backend tokenizer errors showing "OOM during tokenization" in the stacktrace. suspect quant kernel bump in latest bundle.
ajay: seeing the same in cluster logs (k8s). node-level OOM not reported, it's process OOM in model runtime. traces attached to PD incident.
sam: rolling deploy started at 14:10 UTC, image tag embed-v2:20240902-rc4. Last good was rc2. rc3 had quant-changes.
maria: can anyone confirm if rc4 includes the new quant kernel (FP4) switch? I think rc3/rc4 enabled the optimized kernel flag.
sam: yes rc4 flipped runtime flag QUANT_FASTPATH=true and bumped tensor-kernel to 2.1.0.
katie: if quant path is causing OOMs we should fallback to safe quant. Options: 1) pause rollout and divert traffic, 2) rollback canary to previous image, 3) toggle safe-quant via runtime flag on canaries. We need customer impact assessment first.
maria: quick check on external errors — outbound error rate to customers in us-west-2 jumps from 0.2% -> 3.8% for embed endpoints in last 3m. No widespread 5xx on hosted-api global yet, traffic is still limited to canary fraction (5%).
incident-bot: PD escalation policy triggered: no ack from second-level after 2m — paging next escalation.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-INC-12345 escalated to oncall-secondary (next-oncall).
next-oncall: ack — joining. any mitigation underway?
ajay: I can run a scoped rollback of the canary replicas to rc2 if we want to immediately stop the regressions. Command: ```kubectl -n runtime set image deployment/model-embed-canary model-embed=embed-v2:20240902-rc2 --record```
maria: that seems safest. How fast will the rollback propagate?
sam: rollout pause would also work: ```deployctl pause rollout embed-v2 --canary``` but I've seen partial stuck pods with pause. Rollback will replace pods with known-good image quicker.
maria: if we rollback canary to rc2, we should also open a quick postmortem ticket and pin rc4 rollout. I'll coordinate with release.
katie: customer comms: impact limited to canary customers (internal test tenants + 5% traffic). Recommend notifying SRE lead and support with template: "Canary regression observed for embed-v2; mitigation: rolled back canary; monitoring for follow-up."
sam: executing rollback now. running ajay's command.
sam: ```$ kubectl -n runtime set image deployment/model-embed-canary model-embed=embed-v2:20240902-rc2 --record
deployment.apps/model-embed-canary image updated
Waiting for rollout to finish...```
maria: monitoring logs... pod restarts drop to zero, p95 latency returning to baseline within 30s.
ajay: confirmed metrics normalizing, error rate back to 0.25% in canary window.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-INC-12345 marked acknowledged and resolved by automation after rollback resolved symptoms.
maria: marking action items: 1) revert QUANT_FASTPATH flag in release branch for rc4, 2) add canary-specific memory guard and OOM alert, 3) add fail-safe to pause quant fastpath for future rollouts.  I'll create tickets and tag release-engineering.
next-oncall: leaving handoff notes for next rotation. If any follow-ups come after 15m, ping me.
maria: thumbs up. closing thread, will file postmortem doc with timeline and logs. :thumbsup:
